description: This Scala source file defines protobuf-related functions for Spark SQL, including methods to convert between protobuf binary format and Catalyst values, supporting descriptor files, descriptor sets, Java classes, and options.

methods.name: from_protobuf
methods.description: Converts protobuf binary column to Catalyst value using descriptor file, descriptor set, or Java class, with various overloads.
